The reference set changed in this release, so most long-prompt rows start a new record. Long prompts are half as long as before (#2617): 5,000 tokens, and 1,000 for the 27B. A row is compared only with one after a prompt of about the same length (#2623). The OptiQ 35B-A3B cases now run its DFlash2 package, and the 27B at an 18 GB limit is no longer measured (#2617). Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is new: it runs streamed from the SSD, drafting with its own prediction head (#2558, #2564, #2577).
Each task is now measured with one reply, so the comparison rows carry the spread of a single reply. The 9B's slower first token after a short essay prompt was not repeated when the same reply was measured again on this build. The cause of the faster short-prompt replies on the 9B and the 27B is unclear: MLX 0.32.5 (#2602) and the 27B's new matmul slice counts (#2619) are the likely sources, but neither was isolated.
## What's new
- **Qwen3.8-Flash-Next runs streamed from the SSD.** It drafts one token ahead with its own prediction head by default, and looks up each reply token's experts inside the MLX graph. - **Models read partly from the SSD now draft with their draft model** when the memory limit leaves room for it beside them. Drafting skips rounds that cannot pay off. - **A dense model's drafted reply now equals its plain reply,** through row-exact kernels for the draft tree and the one-token step. - **Faster draft rounds on the dense 27B,** faster prompts on the streaming engine, and MLX 0.32.5. - **`astronomical status` and `/v1/status`** report a reply's peak MLX memory, draft rounds on the streaming engine, and which draft model a streamed model uses.
## Fixes
- The Maximum model RAM slider follows a limit changed elsewhere while its popover is open, unless you have moved it. - After a request moved the model to streaming, a slightly smaller next request no longer loads the model twice. - A draft model's memory is counted with the request's, so tight memory limits are respected. - Problem reports and the daily count are sent from Stable only.
## Compatibility
- Your downloaded models, conversations and settings are kept. - Two settings no engine read are retired and removed from your settings file on upgrade: `chunking.experimental_decode_stage_attribution_enabled` and `chunking.experimental_prefill_stage_attribution_enabled`. - New setting `chunking.multi_token_prediction_draft_tokens` (0 to 3): how many tokens a streamed model with a prediction head drafts ahead. By default the engine chooses. - The Astronomical skill is updated to version 5.
## Distribution
Signed with a Developer ID, built with Hardened Runtime, and notarized by Apple. The disk image, these notes and the Sparkle update feed are bound to the SHA-256 digests in the release manifest.
